description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation 0f the United States Coast Guard's intent to award 70Z04026Q50226B000 as a Brand Name purchase order for two (2) Steyr Motor engines; DIESEL ENGINES; P/N: SE164E40Z ; NSN: 5325 01-543-6966. This determination is in accordance with 13.106-1(b) Only one brand and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. For more information on the circumstances please reference the attached JOTFOC.  This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued.
